create_batch_from_dict: create a Batch object by passing keyword arguments as tensors to wrap into batch data
load_batch_from_gc: load a Batch from Game Context using Batch.load with input_reply, desc, and group_id
transfer_batch_to_gpu: transfer batch data from CPU to GPU using cpu2gpu or transfer_cpu2gpu methods
register_callback_for_gcwrapper: register a callback function for a GCWrapper key using reg_callback to process input and reply batches
start_gcwrapper_game_loop: start the game environment loop by calling GCWrapper.Start after registering all required callbacks
